name: Coevera
description: Coevera CRM gives AI agents full access to your Coevera CRM data. Search, create, and update Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Tasks, and Appointments — all through natural language. Link activities to records, manage your sales pipeline and navigate complex relationships across CRM entities. Whether you're logging a follow-up, qualifying a lead, or building an end-to-end onboarding workflow, Coevera CRM lets your AI act directly inside your sales data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Coevera to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Coevera to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-server.coevera.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Coevera MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coevera lists 14 MCP tools, including bulk_archive_leads, bulk_archive_opportunities, bulk_move_opportunities, bulk_qualify_leads, change_ownership, complete_step_checklist_item, create_records, get_records, get_step_checklist_status, me, meta_describe_entity, and meta_list_entity_types.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Coevera?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Coevera in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Coevera requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Coevera is developed by Pipelinersales Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
